findings.title: Potential conflict with Al Noor Hospitality Group non-compete (§12.1)
findings.explanation: Potential conflict — not a breach determination. Al Noor Hospitality Group §12.1: No data analytics, AI or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business (hotel owners/operators, or distribution / revenue-management / guest-analytics providers to hotels) headquartered in, or for properties in, the GCC (UAE, KSA, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman). Status: active, until 14 Sep 2029 (Term ends 14 Mar 2028 (§6.1) + 18-month Restricted Period ≈ 14 Sep 2029.). The restriction binds AtliQ's Affiliates too, so signing through the other AtliQ entity does not avoid it. This contract matches every element — hospitality sector: hotels, resort · GCC geography: United Arab Emirates, Dubai, Oman, Muscat · analytics / AI / revenue-management services: analytics, AI, AI-based, models, sentiment. Related: waiver (spent) — One-off consent under §12.4 for the Seaside Hotels (Muscat) demand-forecasting SOW only. Excludes extensions, any other Hospitality Business and all AtliQ Affiliates.
findings.contract_quote: | 10 | BlueOrchid Dubai Business Bay | Dubai | United Arab Emirates |

evidence.quote: the Supplier undertakes that neither it nor any of its Affiliates shall, during the Restricted Period, directly or indirectly, provide data analytics, artificial intelligence or revenue-management services to any Hospitality Business in the GCC.
evidence.label: Signed: al noor hospitality msa §12.1 (Active until 14 Sep 2029)

evidence.quote: "Hospitality Business" means any person, firm or entity that owns, operates, manages or franchises hotels, resorts or serviced apartments, or that provides distribution, revenue-management or guest-analytics services to any such person, firm or entity.

services are provided "in the GCC" if the Hospitality Business receiving them is headquartered in, or the services relate to properties or operations located in, any state of the GCC, irrespective of where the services are performed.
The Supplier shall procure that each of its Affiliates complies with this Clause 12 as if it were a party to this Agreement, and any breach by an Affiliate shall be deemed a breach by the Supplier.
"Restricted Period" means the Term and the period of eighteen (18) months following the expiry or termination of this Agreement.

This consent is strictly limited to the Seaside SOW. It does not extend to (a) any other services provided to Seaside, including any extension, renewal, change order or follow-on statement of work, unless separately consented to in writing by the Client; (b) any other Hospitality Business, whether in the Sultanate of Oman or elsewhere in the GCC; or (c) any Affiliate of the Supplier.
